summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.14 per share declared by Provident Financial Holdings' board. This is a standard capital-return event with no special-situation attributes such as a tender, activism, or M&A. The dividend will be paid on June 4, 2026 to holders of record as of May 14, 2026. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is involved. The filing is purely informational under Item 8.01 and contains no structural changes, advisor appointments, or unusual terms.
